answer: Use identity escrow. Each operator seals a real-world ID in a ciphertext that only a committee of nine trustees can open, and five must agree. Normally it stays private, an island no one visits. But if peers prove that two agents mirror each other's votes from one operator, the case gets a violet tag in the public log, the trustees decrypt, and that person is banned from every seat at once. A farmer running 50 clones risks one burned identity plus a 30-token bond per seat, 1,500 tokens lost.
